features.title: Agent commission on deposits (Phase 4)
features.behavior: When a deposit attributed to an agent (Telebirr or M-PESA) is credited, that agent earns a configured percentage of the deposit as commission, credited to their wallet in the SAME TypeORM transaction as the player credit (never a balance change without a ledger entry). Rate is DB-backed config depositCommissionPct (0-100). Commission is integer minor units, rounded DOWN, clamped to the deposit amount, and idempotent on the deposit reference (idempotencyKey deposit-commission:{provider}:{reference}) so a retry/duplicate submit never double-pays. Ledger entryType 'agent_receipt', sourceType 'deposit_commission'. Agent self-performance (GET /agent/performance) and admin overview (GET /admin/agents/performance) now also report depositCount, depositVolumeMinor, depositCommissionEarnedMinor.

features.title: Authoritative M-PESA portal receipt verification (PDF)
features.behavior: Mirrors the Telebirr receipt fetch for M-PESA. The confirmation SMS links to https://m-pesabusiness.safaricom.et/receipt/<code>, a Next.js SPA that loads its data from GET /api/receipt/getReceipt?trxNo=<code> → { responseCode, responseDescription, base64Data } where base64Data is a receipt PDF. responseCode '0' proves the code is a REAL, settled transaction (a forged SMS code returns e.g. 2032 'does not exist'). The PDF text layer is UNMASKED — full sender/receiver name + phone, settled amount, payment date (EAT), transaction type — unlike the SMS which masks the counterparty (251714***707 vs real 251714267707). New MpesaReceiptClientService (leaf module) fetches the JSON (direct or via MPESA_PORTAL_URL proxy), decodes the base64 PDF, extracts text with pdf-parse, and parses it (pure parseMpesaReceiptText). Deposit verifier: when MPESA_PORTAL_ENABLED, the portal receipt is authoritative — confirms existence+success, settled amount == SMS amount, unmasked receiver == matched agent; hard-rejects conflicts and not-found; a portal OUTAGE falls back to SMS unless MPESA_PORTAL_STRICT. Withdrawal verifier: same authoritative path — unmasked receiver == player destination, settled amount == net payout; outage BLOCKS release (admin approve is the override).
